content:
Chapter 16 Assignment Of Tasks

"City Lord, Xiaoxue should just be angry for a moment, after all, you,"

At this time, Gu Chen remembered this and spoke.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded and sighed heavily.

This was his first time leaving Lu Xue, and this time he had been there for only three hundred years. He didn't dare to think about how his daughter came through in the three hundred years without him.

"Lord Lu, your daughter may have misunderstood."

On the side, Ouyang Yanqing suddenly smiled.

"Huh? What's the misunderstanding?"

Lu Daosheng said in confusion.

"Your daughter probably thought of me wrongly. I ask you, have you brought another woman back?"

Ouyang Yanqing remembered the look of Lu Daosheng's daughter looking at him at that time, and then smiled faintly.

As a woman, she still knows it very well.

When Lu Daosheng heard Ouyang Yanqing's words, he was stunned and immediately understood.

Bang!

Lu Daosheng patted his forehead.

Why did I react so slowly?

I just said why my daughter was so used to me. It turned out to be a misunderstanding.

However, it is understandable that my daughter has some resentment towards her if she has not returned for three hundred years.

After all, my wife has not come back for more than ten years, and I feel a little resentful deep down, let alone my daughter's father.

When he was in place, Lu Daosheng shook his head.

Let’s explain after a while Xiaoxue has calmed down.

On the side, Gu Chen said, "City Lord, just leave Xiaoxue to me."

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng finally showed his first smile after coming back.

"Thank you for your hard work over the years."

Then Lu Daosheng handed Gu Chen a cosmic crystal stone.

"This thing will be of great help to you to break through to the next level."

Seeing the universe crystal stone, Gu Chen was stunned and said seriously: "City Lord, you are so serious. Xiaoxue is my apprentice, and this is my duty."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

Then the two of them exchanged a few greetings and Gu Chen left.

On the side, Ouyang Yanqing said with a little jealousy: "You can just give him a cosmic crystal stone in his realm. Isn't it too luxurious?"

Lu Daosheng did not answer, but smiled and said, "You are the first guest I brought back to Huangcheng. If you like it, you can stay here for more days. When will you miss home, come and find me."

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing understood that Lu Daosheng was going to work hard.

Then Ouyang Yanqing hurriedly said, "Okay, okay, you go, I'll just take a walk by myself."

In his tone, he was quite anxious.

She even wanted to stay here for the rest of her life.

And now that the city lord has spoken, she is not polite.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng didn't say anything anymore.

"Then you pay attention to safety."

Then Lu Daosheng disappeared from the spot.

Seeing Lu Daosheng leaving, Ouyang Yanqing suddenly felt the surroundings carefully. After confirming that there was no horror, he slowly smiled.

"I would have liked my temple of eternity."

"Tsk tsk tsk, so many, which one should I come first?"

After thinking for a while, Ouyang Yanqing jumped and ran under the ancient tree of enlightenment.

It is hard to believe that the Eternal Lord, who has changed his color in the Eternal Star System, has become like this here.

......

Somewhere in the void in the deserted city.

Lu Daosheng opened up a small space with bare hands.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng waved his hand and dozens of people appeared in front of him.

There were Awei, the guards and servants in the city lord's mansion, and the unknown man and the other Lu Daosheng were taken in.

"We've met the city lord."

When Awei and his people from the city lord's mansion saw Lu Daosheng, they immediately hurriedly said respectfully.

Seeing Awei and others, Lu Daosheng smiled with satisfaction.

"Thank you all these days."

The flow rate in the world in the palm is also different from that in the outside world. This is something he deliberately wants them to improve their strength in a short period of time.

And now, the effect is obviously very good.

At this time, Awei and others were at least the existence of saints.

To reach this level is not only about the accumulation of resources, but also about sufficient time.

Because in the world in the palm, Awei and others have been through ten thousand years, which is the terrifying method of the Heavenly Destiny Realm.

Over the past ten thousand years, Lu Daosheng would also give them guidance from time to time.

And now, it’s finally time to collect the dishes.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Awei and others' eyes were slightly rosy.

All their current achievements were given by their city lord, Lu Daosheng.

They knew this very well.

And they practice so hard that one day they can help the city lord share their worries.

Looking at the strange crowd around them, they knew that their city had done something big.

"City Lord, from now on, we will do our best to do our best to do your business."

Awei spoke first.

Behind him, the people from the City Lord's Mansion also hurriedly said, "City Lord, so are we."

Looking at A Wei who had reached the quasi-emperor realm, Lu Daosheng was very pleased.

Buzz —

The next moment, an aggressive sword appeared in Lu Daosheng's hands.

Suddenly, everyone present explained that they felt a violent feeling.

I saw Lu Daosheng gently stroke the long sword, and the long sword suddenly fell into peace.

"This knife is called Zhantian, and from then on, it will be yours."

After handing the long sword to Awei, Lu Daosheng spoke.

After taking the long sword, Awei kowtowed heavily to Lu Daosheng.

"Thank you, the city lord, for giving the knife."

Lu Daosheng nodded and gave a few instructions.

From now on, the people in their City Lord's Mansion will be responsible for all the rules in the deserted city. Anyone who violates their rules can be executed on the spot.

And Awei also got some privileges, such as being able to recruit some extraordinary talents to expand the population of the City Lord's Mansion, and all of these are managed by himself.

Waving his hand, Awei and others left.

Then, only some strong talents recruited from outside were left.

"Wuming."

...

After being stunned for a long time, the unknown man realized that he was being called.

"City Lord."

In the palm time, he also got the help of Lu Daosheng, his strength was improved, and he also knew Lu Daosheng's identity.

The Lord of the Deserted City, although he didn't know what the Deserted City looked like, he knew it must be not simple.

Just based on the world in the palm, it was not something he could imagine.

Looking at the unknown man, Lu Daosheng pondered for a moment and said, "From now on, why don't you be called Huang Shou?"

"Huang Shou, what do you mean?"

"I want you to be the defender of my Huangcheng. From now on, you will be the first line of defense of my Huangcheng."

Hearing this, the unknown man was silent for a moment and nodded in agreement.

"Okay, I'll do it."

The unknown man didn't say much and finally agreed.

After being defeated by Lu Daosheng at the beginning, he thought about practicing hard to defeat Lu Daosheng. In fact, after a defeat, his strength has greatly improved, and his road has become farther.

But when he saw the world in Lu Daosheng's palm, he realized how big the gap between him and Lu Daosheng was.

It's too far, even impossible.

He can't be confused.

Just be the defender.

Buzz--

At this time, another long sword suddenly appeared in Lu Daosheng's hand.

Instantly, countless violent sword intents continued to flow out of the long sword.

This sword is very spiritual.

This time, Lu Daosheng did not appease the long sword, but handed it directly to Huang Shou.

After receiving the long sword, Huang Shou's face suddenly changed.

Boom!

An unknown peak of the breath suddenly burst out from Huang Shou's body.

Feeling Huang Shou's breath, everyone around trembled and had difficulty breathing.

Lu Daosheng pressed his hand down, and everyone felt better.

In the mansion of the city lord of Huangcheng, Ouyang Yanqing suddenly looked up at the void, frowning slightly.

She just felt a palpitating feeling.

This city is really full of crouching tigers and hidden dragons.

"What a wild sword."

I don't know how long it took before Huang Shou had a preliminary control of this long sword.

I have been practicing swords for a lifetime, but this is the first time I have seen such a sword. The city lord is indeed not an ordinary person.

"This sword is yours from now on. I hope you can completely control it one day."

Lu Daosheng said.

Hearing this, Huang Shou bowed respectfully.

"Thank you for the sword, Lord. Unless I die in battle, I will not let an enemy enter the city."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng waved his hand.

Huang Shou appeared directly on the gate of Huangcheng.

Looking back at the entire Huangcheng, Huang Shou was stunned.

This is Huangcheng?

My god, I made a fortune, a fortune!

Looking down at the wall under his feet, Huang Shou chopped it with his sword.

Bang!

Huang Shou was directly shocked and retreated repeatedly, and his entire arm lost consciousness.

And the wall was just added with a very inconspicuous scratch.

After a long pause, Huang Shou murmured: "Does this city really need me to defend it?"
